resourceSystem.name: Hexbreaker Charges
resourceSystem.decay: 1 charge every 2 rounds out of combat; 0 on long rest
generation: +1 when enemy within 30ft casts a spell
+1 on Draw Null Salt or turn start in null-zone
resourceSystem.spending: Fuels anti-magic strikes, kinetic dispels, null-zones, and execution strikes

coreFeatures.name: Null Strike
coreFeatures.description: Strike with cold bog-iron. Deal weapon damage (slashing/bludgeoning). If target is concentrating on a spell, they make their concentration check with disadvantage.

coreFeatures.name: Draw Null Salt
coreFeatures.description: Scatter a handful of alchemical null-salts across weapon or boots. Gain +1 Hexbreaker Charge and +2 to saving throws against hexes until the end of your next turn.

optionalSpells.name: Shadow Hunt
optionalSpells.description: Trace residual magical footprints and heat leaks within 60 ft. Reveals invisible magical trails for 10 minutes.

optionalSpells.name: Salt Ward
optionalSpells.description: Sprinkle null-salt barrier. Absorbs 4 points of incoming magical/elemental damage. Lasts 1 round.

optionalSpells.name: Hex Strike
optionalSpells.description: 2d8 slashing + 1d6 force damage. If target has active magical buffs, dispel one minor buff.

optionalSpells.name: Silver Blade
optionalSpells.description: 1d8 slashing + 1d4 radiant damage. Deals maximum damage against unholy, necrotic, or shapeshifted targets.

optionalSpells.name: Dark Pursuit
optionalSpells.description: Leap up to 25 ft toward a creature that cast a spell since your last turn.

optionalSpells.name: Bog-Iron Parry
optionalSpells.description: Deflect incoming spell attack, reducing damage by 1d10 + Agility and gaining +1 Charge.

optionalSpells.name: Severing Slash
optionalSpells.description: 2d10 slashing damage; target cannot teleport or use planar movement for 1 round.

optionalSpells.name: Disruptive Shout
optionalSpells.description: Force all casting enemies to make a Will save or suffer 1 round of Silence.

optionalSpells.name: Null-Salts Flask
optionalSpells.description: Throw a flask creating a 10 ft radius null-zone. Magic cannot be cast inside for 2 rounds.

optionalSpells.name: Witch Scent
optionalSpells.description: Discern the exact school and tier of any active enchantment within 100 ft.

optionalSpells.name: Chain Shatter
optionalSpells.description: 3d8 slashing damage; shatters physical and magical shields (+2d8 bonus damage to ward pools).

optionalSpells.name: Cold-Iron Gouge
optionalSpells.description: 2d8 piercing damage; target bleeds for 1d6 physical damage per turn whenever they spend mana.

optionalSpells.name: Leaden Veil
optionalSpells.description: Gain advantage on all saves against charm, fear, and psychic influence for 1 minute.

optionalSpells.name: Grounding Spike
optionalSpells.description: Drive a cold-iron spike into the terrain. Lightning, fire, and storm spells within 20 ft are redirected to the spike.

optionalSpells.name: Punishing Counter
optionalSpells.description: Triggered when an enemy casts within 5 ft; make an immediate weapon strike dealing 2d10 damage.

optionalSpells.name: Abyssal Sever
optionalSpells.description: 3d10 force/slashing damage; banishes summoned minions with HP <= 15 instantly.

optionalSpells.name: Veil Breaker
optionalSpells.description: Cleanse all illusion, invisibility, and shapeshift effects within a 20 ft radius.

optionalSpells.name: Shackles of Bog-Iron
optionalSpells.description: Cold-iron chains erupt; target speed reduced to 0 and cannot cast spells requiring somatic components for 2 rounds.

optionalSpells.name: Hexbreaker Execution
optionalSpells.description: 4d8 slashing damage; deals +2d8 bonus damage if target has cast a spell this encounter.

optionalSpells.name: Radiant Purge
optionalSpells.description: 3d8 radiant damage to all nearby foes; destroys all magical traps/hazards in the radius.

optionalSpells.name: Ward Inversion
optionalSpells.description: Target enemy magical ward inverts, dealing its remaining shield capacity as pure damage to its bearer.

optionalSpells.name: Occult Dampener
optionalSpells.description: All allies within 15 ft gain +3 to saves against arcane and necrotic spells for 3 rounds.

optionalSpells.name: Bog-Iron Whirlwind
optionalSpells.description: Spin with iron blade; 3d10 slashing to all surrounding enemies and push them back 5 ft.

optionalSpells.name: Mind-Flint Strike
optionalSpells.description: 2d10 psychic/slashing damage; burns 5 points of enemy mana or removes 1 resource charge.

optionalSpells.name: Leyline Anchor
optionalSpells.description: Plants a heavy anchor that suppresses all teleportation, planar travel, and summoning within 40 ft for 1 minute.

optionalSpells.name: Null-Salts Barrage
optionalSpells.description: Cone of dense null-salts; all spells passing through the cone suffer a 50% miscast chance for 2 rounds.

optionalSpells.name: Hexbreaker Storm
optionalSpells.description: 4d10 force damage to all spellcasters in range; interrupts all active concentration immediately.

optionalSpells.name: Apex Predator
optionalSpells.description: For 3 rounds, your weapon strikes deal +2d8 radiant damage against creatures with innate spellcasting.

optionalSpells.name: Silence Shroud
optionalSpells.description: Wrap in total sonic and magical silence; immune to detection by magical scrying, tremorsense, or truesight for 10 minutes.

optionalSpells.name: Sanctuary of Iron
optionalSpells.description: Create a dome of cold-iron runes; completely blocks incoming ranged spell projectiles for 2 rounds.

optionalSpells.name: Judgment Day
optionalSpells.description: 5d10 radiant/slashing damage; if target has cast a spell of tier 4+, target is stunned for 1 round.

optionalSpells.name: Anti-Magic Storm
optionalSpells.description: 5d8 force damage and cleanses all magical effects (friendly and hostile) from all targets in the area.

optionalSpells.name: Sever Ley Threads
optionalSpells.description: Completely severs target creature's connection to magical leylines for 2 rounds; target cannot cast spells.

optionalSpells.name: Null-Salts Apotheosis
optionalSpells.description: Gain temporary HP equal to 5 * your Covenbane level for 3 rounds.

optionalSpells.name: Lethal Anathema
optionalSpells.description: 6d10 radiant/slashing damage; permanently disables the target's highest-tier spell slot for 24 hours.

optionalSpells.name: Rupture Leyline
optionalSpells.description: Rupture the ground in a 40 ft furrow; deals 5d8 force damage and knocks all targets prone.

optionalSpells.name: Orven's Legacy
optionalSpells.description: For 3 rounds, allies within 30 ft gain spell resistance +4 and cannot be charmed or dominated.

optionalSpells.name: Bog-Iron Immuration
optionalSpells.description: Encase yourself in impenetrable null-iron for 1 round; immune to all damage, cannot take actions.

optionalSpells.name: Barbed Vow Fulfillment
optionalSpells.description: 8d10 pure damage against a primary spellcaster boss. Cannot be mitigated or reflected.

optionalSpells.name: Extinguish Spark
optionalSpells.description: 6d12 force damage; target is permanently silenced until a completed long rest.

talentTrees.name: Shadowbane
talentTrees.tagline: Track residual occult spoor, stalk unseen through leylines, and strike from absolute silence.

signature.name: Null Shroud
signature.description: Cloak in cold mist; gain invisibility against magical detection for 3 rounds.

capstone.name: Aegis of Bog-Iron
capstone.description: Project an impenetrable dampening field for 2 rounds.
